stories.title: Broken rail at Conwy disrupts Holyhead to Chester services
stories.summary: A broken rail at Conwy is disrupting train services between Holyhead and Chester. Services may be delayed by up to 60 minutes. Services may be cancelled in both directions between Holyhead and Chester, a route used by passengers travelling through Flintshire toward Chester.
